steps.title: Start the C2 server
steps.body: Flip the server toggle (or let autostart do it). This walkthrough advances the moment the server is actually listening — not on a Next button.

steps.title: Launch an Overlord cycle
steps.body: Press AUTO RUN. The card below turns into a live job card with the cycle's log tail. It advances when a cycle really starts.

steps.title: Arrange your grid
steps.body: Unlock the dashboard, drag a card where you want it, then lock. Advancing requires the real toggle — the lock chip fires it.
